# 0.4.14

## 本次更新

- 锁定/需要订阅的作品现在会在预览卡片显示锁图标，详情页标题下方也会明确提示“需要订阅或购买后才能查看 / 受限 / 需要登录”，不再和 NSFW 打码混淆。
- 修复更新 APK 后偶发黑屏：代理、WebView、OAuth/网页会话恢复都有有界启动预算，超时后仍进入主界面，不再被 Splash 永久卡黑。

- Locked and subscription-gated artwork now shows a lock badge on preview cards and an explicit note under the detail title, so it is no longer confused with NSFW blurring.
- Fixes occasional black screen after an APK update: proxy, WebView, OAuth and web-session restore now have bounded startup budgets, so the app moves past splash even when a restore is slow.
